biography.value: Cinder Giants have grown into their authority. The Heat Aura is now a genuine battlefield hazard at 10 feet rather than a minor inconvenience, and Intimidating Presence gives them a meaningful action economy option against grouped enemies who haven't committed yet. Volcanic Hurl's splash damage means clustered enemies take incidental fire damage even when the hurl targets only one of them. A summoner who gives one a target and keeps allies out of the Heat Aura radius will find it handles the engagement without requiring further management.

system.attacksNotes:
Magma Strike [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 3), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 11 damage (6 + 5 Str) + 3 fire damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 fire damage; target gains Ignited condition.
  • Margin 3: 11 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 fire damage; target gains Burning condition; all creatures within 5 feet of target take 4 fire damage from magma splash.

Volcanic Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 2), Range: 60/120 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 fire damage (10 + 4 Dex); target gains Ignited.
  • Margin 2: 14 fire damage, DR halved (round up); target gains Ignited; all creatures within 5 feet take 4 fire damage.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Heat Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 10 feet take 4 fire damage (Half DR). Powerful Build: The Cinder Giant counts as Huge for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Smoldering Wounds: When the Cinder Giant deals Ignited or Burning condition to a target, that target cannot remove the condition through normal means for 1 round. Magical healing still removes it. Intimidating Presence: As a [Combat] action all creatures within 30 feet that can see and hear it make a Will save (opposed by Cha 4 + Intimidate 5). On failure: target gains the Frightened condition until end of their next turn. Creatures immune to fear are unaffected.
